The '''Refrax Spaceport''' was a [[Space station/Legends|space station]] in the [[Mortex sector/Legends|Mortex sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]]. Controlled by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], the near-[[Orbit/Legends|orbit]] [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]] served as a stop-over point for ships traveling through the sector during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. It was located at the intersection of [[Hyperlane GG734|hyperlanes GG734]] and [[Hyperlane GH972|GH972]].
